findings.claim: A core-pinned incumbent that the per-theme cap pushes out of core falls into the overflow branch and, walked before newcomers, takes an attack slot ahead of higher-ranked overflow names, so the attack sleeve depends on core_hold_rank.
findings.evidence: kuroshio/core/book.py walk_rows (core_pinned before unpinned); only when yesterday's core holds more names in one industry than today's core_per_theme allows (cap lowered or industry relabelled).
findings.repro: PYTHONPATH=.:tests python -c "import test_book as t, kuroshio.core.book as bk; s,r=t._one_theme_screen(); [print(h,[x['ticker'] for x in bk.build_book(s,r,t._ips(),rules=bk.BookRules(core_n=2,core_per_theme=1,attack_n=1,core_hold_rank=h),prev_book={'core':[{'ticker':'T5'},{'ticker':'T6'}]})['attack']]) for h in (0,7)]" prints 0 ['T2'] / 7 ['T6']
